title: Spoofed GCS heartbeats suppress the data-link-loss failsafe
description: PX4 accepts HEARTBEAT unsigned on every link and derives GCS liveness from MAV_TYPE_GCS heartbeats. While the real GCS link is jammed or down, an adversary who can deliver MAVLink to any FC link impersonates the GCS, so the data-link-loss failsafe (DD-05) never triggers and the vehicle flies on without C2 or automatic return. Residual after SR-001: a compromised CC or GCS, both already inside the C2 trust base.
